messages:
Eliza: quick heads-up — customer Nyx reported divergence after a LoRA graft + int4 rollout in staging. Issues: cents dropped (12.00 -> 12) and some short code literals losing ".00". Need a compact repro and mitigation plan.

Marco: I'll assemble a focused eval pack `nyx_cents_code_micro` (400 prompts): invoices, small JS/py snippets with numeric literals, OCR-noise variants. Will mark expected canonical outputs.

Jun: Suggest matrix runs: float32 baseline, int8, bnb4-hybrid, bnb4. For graft try lora_scale 0.55/0.65 and a quick rebias 500/1000 steps. Also test `--kv-policy preserve-prefix` vs `compact`.

Sasha: Run command I used for reproducibility: `rwi run --model nyx-finetune-v3 --eval nyx_cents_code_micro --matrix "quant:float32,int8,bnb4-hybrid,bnb4;lora_scale:0.55,0.65" --workers 6 --pool dedicated-nyx`

eval-bot: job queued 1733333400, id=rivet-1733333333-1. Streaming intermediate metrics.

eval-bot: early summary: float32=98/100; int8=95/100; bnb4-hybrid (best scale 0.65)=92/100; bnb4=76/100. Major failure buckets: trailing cents removed, comma vs dot locale loss, and numeric literals in fenced code losing decimals.

Marco: Example diffs attached:
```
Prompt: "Invoice total: $1,200.00"
float32 -> "$1,200.00" (OK)
bnb4 -> "$1200" (parser mismatch)

Prompt: "```js
const price = 12.00;
```"
float32 -> keeps 12.00
bnb4-hybrid (no rebias) -> "12" in code literal -> test fail
```

Jun: Two mitigations to try: 1) graft + rebias (500 steps) focusing on tokens [",", ".", "0"]; 2) int4-hybrid quant profile and `--sync-tokenizer true`. Also log per-token probs for decimal tokens.

Sasha: Kicking off graft+rebias run: `rwi retrain --model nyx-finetune-v3 --head grafted-head --steps 500 --lr 2.5e-5 --freeze base --focus-tokens ", . 0"` then re-eval with bnb4-hybrid + kv-preserve.

eval-bot: retrain queued run_id=retrain-1733333333-1. Will attach diffs on completion.

eval-bot: retrain complete and re-eval done (run_id=rivet-1733333333-2): bnb4-hybrid + rebias(500) pass=90/100. Cents failures reduced from 9 -> 3, code literal failures reduced but not eliminated. Recommendation: do NOT promote plain bnb4 to prod. Use int8 for prod, bnb4-hybrid+graft+rebias as shadow.

Marco: I'll upload artifacts (token probs, diffs, tokenizer snapshots) and add micro-pack to nightly smoke.

Jun: I'll schedule a kernel parity check across dedicated nodes; if we see per-host variance open INFR-5701. Also add `--force-kernel v2.1` option for parity testing.

Sasha: Action items: Marco automate repeatable graft+rebias job, Jun own kernel parity and tokenizer sync with infra, keep prod on int8, enable bnb4-hybrid+rebias in shadow for 48h with fallback to int8 if error rate >2%. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
